spec.concept: A review that reports each finding with its severity, root cause and recommended fix
spec.scene: Clean brand card with a deep navy background, a thin amber accent rule above the overlay text, and a minimal outlined shield motif in the corner. Text is left-aligned in white with generous margins.
spec.overlay_text: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with an amber accent line and white text reading: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix.

spec.concept: A payout loop where one failing external call blocks every other recipient, and the fix of letting users withdraw instead
spec.scene: Dark navy background with a horizontal row of small square nodes representing recipients connected by a line, one amber node highlighted as the failing call that interrupts the line, with white outlined nodes on either side. Clean technical layout with generous spacing and a calm engineering feel.
spec.overlay_text: one failing recipient can block the whole operation
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a row of recipient nodes connected by a line, with one amber node breaking the line to show a failed external call blocking a batch payout.

spec.concept: Reentrancy happens when state is updated after an external call, so the order of steps matters
spec.scene: Technical card on a deep navy background: two stacked blocks of contract code, with an amber arrow looping from an external call back up into the function before the balance is cleared. A second block below shows the corrected order with the state update placed first.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a contract function where an external call loops back into the function before the balance is cleared, beside the corrected order that updates state first.

spec.concept: Credibility through a track record of completed smart contract audits
spec.scene: A clean brand card with a deep navy background, a single amber accent line beneath the overlay text, and a minimal grove of geometric tree shapes in white along the bottom edge
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with white geometric trees and an amber accent line, reading: completed 12 smart contract audits

spec.concept: Missing caller checks on withdrawal functions let anyone move Ether out of a contract, so withdrawals should be limited to authorized parties.
spec.scene: A minimal navy card with a simple amber padlock icon beside an open vault door, clean geometric shapes, plenty of empty space for the overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with an amber padlock and vault door, with the text: Limit withdrawals to authorized parties.

spec.concept: ERC-4626 vault inflation attack: a donation to an empty vault skews the share price so the first depositor receives zero shares
spec.scene: A minimal technical card on a deep navy background. A simple vault outline holds a single amber share token, while an arrow labeled as a direct token transfer drops into the vault from the side. Clean line work, a calm and precise engineering look, with plenty of empty space for the overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Navy card with an amber outline of a vault holding one share token, with a direct transfer arrow entering the vault, and the text rounds down to zero shares.
